title: submit_account_ttl and submit_default_auto_delete drop the driver's Err
trigger: Pick a self-destruct period or auto-delete preset while the chats path is not active or another account mutation is pending
effect: The radio snaps back (value is authoritative) with no note and no retry hint
fix: On Err set StatusNote::error (as submit_logout does) or disable the radios while not sendable

title: RefCell borrow_mut().take() in the dialog content closure (one-shot body cell)
trigger: The kit calls the content closure again while it runs (re-entrancy), which no known path does
effect: Would panic on a nested borrow; today the guard is a temporary dropped in the same statement
fix: try_borrow_mut with an empty div fallback, or hand the element over without a RefCell

title: autoload mark is set to the list length before load_more_event_log sends; a failed send or failed page keeps the mark so no further automatic load happens
trigger: Short log that needs more pages, load_more send errors once
effect: List stays at its length with 'loading older' spinner until the user scrolls to the top again (the scroll hook is the only other path)
fix: clear the mark when the send errors or the page fails (stage Asked{len}->Idle)

title: apply_event_log_search and save_event_log_filter store the new query/filter in the session before the refresh; when the refresh send fails the log still shows the old rows under the new title/filter
trigger: Type a search or Save a filter while the refresh send errors
effect: Header says 'selected actions' or shows the typed query while rows are the previous result; the stored query now equals the box so a retype of the same text is ignored (query == current)
fix: stage the query/filter with the request (Pending{query,filter}) and commit on the answer

title: event_log_ids RefCell borrow_mut held across ListState reset/splice/remeasure calls in render
trigger: Render of the list while the ListState calls back
effect: Non-test RefCell guard held across calls into GPUI (panic-safety rule 6); a re-entrant borrow would panic
fix: copy the plan out, drop the guard, then call the list; or store ids in the ListState owner without RefCell

title: event log poll tick does not check the passcode lock; it polls while the dialog is open under a locked app and window active
fix: refused_while_locked in event_log_poll_tick (or close the page on lock)

title: EventLogSearch::shows (Option<ChatId>) mirrors which chat the search box text belongs to, resynced from per-frame upkeep
trigger: Open recent actions of chat A, then chat B
effect: Box text and stored query are two sources; typing sets the stored query only after the debounce, upkeep may overwrite text when shows != open chat
fix: make the box value a function of the page (EventLogPage owns the input) and drop shows

title: The recent-actions poll timer keeps ticking while the window is inactive
trigger: Open Recent Actions, switch to another app
effect: event_log_poll_tick keeps returning true and the timer loop wakes every interval while window_active is false, doing nothing; the missed events are fetched only at the next tick after reactivation
fix: Pause the task when the window deactivates and restart on activation (the poll stage holds the Task)

title: Accepting a conference invitation has no in-flight stage: the Join and Decline buttons stay live
trigger: Double-click Join on a messageGroupCall row
effect: joinGroupCall is sent twice; Decline after Join is also sent; row only changes on TDLib's update
fix: a per-message AcceptStage { Idle, Sent(RequestId) } in the history UI

title: Rename closes the box and the in-call composer clears on a queued send; a later TDLib failure loses the typed text
trigger: Rename the video chat or send a call message that TDLib then refuses
effect: title_dialog is taken and composer set to empty when the request is queued; the failure lands only in group_call_error with the text gone
fix: keep the text in a Sending stage that holds the RequestId and clears on success

title: Invite picker: failed contacts fetch reads as 'No contacts to invite' and is only retried on reopen
effect: fetch_contacts result dropped with let _; users_state.contacts error is not shown, the list says nobody to invite
fix: show Fetch::Failed with a retry in the picker

title: open_box(PaymentForm) is called before the send result is known; on a failed send the old payments.dialog is left Some while the checkout is wiped
trigger: Checkout dialog open, press Buy again (or open another invoice link) and the send is refused
effect: The previous PaymentDialog object (inputs, prefill) stays in self.payments.dialog with a Closed checkout: dialog is hidden by payment_dialog_visible but its state outlives the checkout and a later open reuses a stale open intent
fix: Open the box only on Ok; clear payments.dialog in the same transition that closes the checkout

title: Game score answers are matched by (chat, message) key, not by the RequestId held in the stage (Loading { request: None } is never .sent())
trigger: Tap Scores, tap again to close, tap again to reopen before the first answer arrives
effect: The first request's answer fills (or fails) the second panel while its own request is still in flight; the second answer then overwrites it, so it self-corrects
fix: call Fetch::sent(request) after send_game_high_scores and apply with Fetch::answered/failed(request)

title: PermissionAsk stays Asking when the asking window closes before the prompt is answered
trigger: On macOS press record in a chat window while the camera or microphone prompt is up, close that chat window; the scoped task's update returns Gone and never sets Idle
effect: Later presses that still find the device undetermined return silently at the Asking check until restart; the answer of the ask is never read
fix: Reset PermissionAsk in the window's closing path (or hold the wait Task in the Asking variant so dropping it ends the ask)

title: Read stages hold only a job number while their timer and worker tasks are detach()ed (also send_box_thumbnails.rs:53-80, send_box_options.rs:134)
trigger: Attach a file, then remove it or let the timer fire first
effect: Late worker results are dropped by the job check, but a written scratch JPEG/thumbnail is never removed; nothing cancels the work
fix: Reading { job, worker: Task, timer: Task } so dropping the stage cancels both

title: One-shot Rc<RefCell<Option<body>>> taken with borrow_mut inside the dialog's Fn content closure (same in translate_ui/mod.rs:542)
trigger: The kit calls the content closure twice for one built dialog.
effect: The second call renders an empty div (a blank box), and a re-entrant call would panic on borrow_mut.
fix: Build the body inside the closure, or use try_borrow_mut and keep the element cloneable
